purpose: Static art-direction review; not runtime assets.

prompts.name: 01-dialogue
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity widescreen 16:9 game UI concept screenshot for the ORIGINAL Vietnamese school journalism / social-life game "HỒI ÂM", set in the coastal city Hải Vọng. This is an art-direction review concept, not a working app. Premium anime narrative-game finish, expressive typography, exceptionally disciplined information hierarchy and generous negative space. ORIGINAL design: no Persona/Danganronpa logos, no recreation of any existing game's layouts, signature menu silhouettes, shattered glass, fonts or icon systems. Inspiration is only atmospheric elegance, fluid depth and confident scale.
Shared visual identity for the set: ink navy #102D42, ocean teal #087F8C, airy turquoise #62D6D0, warm paper #F4F1E7, sunlight yellow #F6C968 in small focal accents. Coastal daylight, restrained sea-glass translucency, layered tidal curves and editorial column rules, a tiny original wave-and-quotation-mark insignia. Soft screen-print grain used sparingly. Mix clean Vietnamese-capable sans-serif body lettering with large elegant editorial display headings. Avoid generic SaaS dashboards, equal-size rounded cards, neon cyberpunk grids, giant diagonal Persona menus, gratuitous gauges, bloom, visual noise. Large calm reading surfaces, asymmetrical expressive silhouettes, a clear sense of layers entering in motion. No explanatory annotations or fake watermarks outside the screen. Text specified below must be legible and Vietnamese diacritics correct.
Asset: 01 dialogue and response selection.
Input image 1 is ONLY the identity reference for Diệp Khuê (male, short dark hair, white school shirt, teal tie and brown satchel). Input image 2 is ONLY the identity reference for Lục Thanh Vân (female, long brown hair, yellow flower clip, white blouse and teal bow/skirt). Preserve their recognizable facial designs, uniforms and accessories. These are NOT screenshots to edit; generate a new scene and new UI.
Composition: a beautiful softly illustrated Vietnamese school newsroom at golden coastal afternoon, windows revealing a small distant harbor, desks with newspaper proofs. Vân is the large active speaking portrait at right, Khuê a quieter cropped foreground portrait at left. Integrate portraits elegantly with the scene rather than placing them in card boxes. Upper-left an unobtrusive date/time seal reading "THỨ NĂM" and "CHIỀU · CLB"; upper-right small "HỒI ÂM" wordmark.
Lower third: wide luminous warm-paper dialogue reading surface with a gently curved tidal edge and teal editorial rules, adequate breathing room, speaker label "LỤC THANH VÂN", dialogue exact: "Một bài báo tốt bắt đầu từ việc lắng nghe." Three readable response strips rise lightly above the dialogue surface near center-left; first selected in sunlight yellow: "Cùng kiểm tra nguồn tin.", then "Cho mình xem bản thảo.", then "Kể mình nghe thêm nhé." Bottom-right small readable "Tiếp tục ↵". Express warmth, subtle anticipation and premium composition; this must look like an actual polished narrative game frame, not a poster.

Asset: 02 main pause/navigation menu. ONE widescreen game screenshot, not a grid of thumbnails.
Reference image 1 is our original Hồi Âm dialogue concept: use only its wave/quotation insignia, warm-paper accents, coastal world, character identity and original art direction to keep the set cohesive. Reference image 2 is the identity reference for Diệp Khuê. Generate a NEW composition and new menu, not an edit of the dialogue screenshot.
Composition: elegant expansive ocean-teal and deep-ink-blue pause menu. An airy illustrated harbor panorama bleeds into the top/background through sea-glass layers; a confident cropped three-quarter Khuê illustration occupies the right third, holding his newspaper club notebook, warm side light. On left/center a typographic navigation composition with generous room, asymmetrical curved tidal rail and fine editorial rules. Navigation stays horizontal/vertical readable, not tilted, not huge angular shapes. Menu items: "HỒ SƠ" selected, "ĐỒNG ĐỘI", "LỊCH", "NHẬT KÝ", "THIẾT LẬP". Active item highlighted as a sunlight-yellow editorial underline and floating small quotation/wave marker, other items cream-white against blue. Large editorial display heading "HỒI ÂM" top-left with small "Hải Vọng · Tuần 02". The center selected-page teaser shows "Hồ sơ đang mở" with two spacious slim story strips "Khoản thu câu lạc bộ" and "Sân bóng đóng cửa", subtle folio numbers "01" and "02", no dense dashboard cards. Bottom-left compact secondary status "Năng lượng 3/4" and "450đ". Bottom-right tidy control prompts "↵ Chọn" and "Esc Trở lại". Convey the exact instant after menu layers settle into place: layered depth, flowing editorial geometry, youthful confidence and calm legibility. Use sophisticated clean sans body lettering, sharper editorial heading typography. Less beige than the dialogue, more ocean-teal, but unmistakably one design family.

Asset: 03 exploration HUD and pixel newsroom.
Image 1 is the established original art direction for this set: carry its ink teal, warm paper, yellow focus, wave curves and editorial rules into a light functional gameplay overlay. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the existing top-down pixel-art newsroom world and small character sprites; do not copy its old page header, old HUD, browser framing, controls or rectangular panels.
Generate a polished widescreen game screenshot. The majority of the screen is a richly crafted TOP-DOWN PIXEL-ART Vietnamese school newsroom: wooden floor, newspaper desks, bookshelves, potted plants, windows with a distant sunlit harbor, several small anime-style school-uniform sprites. Keep the world readable and navigable, with moderate scene density. Integrate a very elegant compact overlay: upper left warm-paper date seal "THỨ NĂM", small "CHIỀU · PHÒNG CLB"; upper right a slim ink-teal status ribbon "Năng lượng 3 / 4" and "450 đ", small original icons. Left edge a restrained editorial objective panel taking at most 15% of screen area: heading "ĐANG THEO DÕI", readable objective "Trao đổi với Vân về bản thảo." Near the main player and Vân sprites, small floating interaction hint "E · Trò chuyện", selected yellow, without covering their bodies. Bottom-left unobtrusive location caption "TÒA SOẠN HỒI ÂM"; bottom-right tiny controls "M · Bản đồ" and "Esc · Menu". No large portraits, giant quest boxes, mobile joystick, combat health bars or generic fantasy-RPG HUD. Preserve a continuous playable world, thoughtful negative space around overlays, premium balance between pixel game and editorial graphic design. Text must be readable with accurate Vietnamese diacritics.

Asset: 04 investigation dossier / editorial case file.
Image 1 is the style reference from this original game's menu concept. Image 2 is ONLY the character identity reference for Lục Thanh Vân; preserve her long brown hair, yellow flower clip and white blouse with teal bow.
Create a high-fidelity widescreen dossier game screen with beautifully balanced typography and ample whitespace. A deep ocean-teal background with quiet tidal curves frames a large warm-paper editorial folio occupying the central two-thirds. Left narrow navigation rail, original tiny wave/quotation insignia, heading "HỒ SƠ", items "Tổng quan" (active yellow), "Nguồn tin", "Bản thảo". Main folio large elegant heading "Khoản thu câu lạc bộ", a small eyebrow "HỒ SƠ 01 · ĐANG XÁC MINH", below one short readable sentence "Làm rõ khoản thu và người phụ trách." Below, a restrained three-step editorial list, generous spacing, fine teal rules: "01 · Thu thập thông tin", "02 · Đối chiếu chứng từ", "03 · Hoàn thiện bản thảo". An inset small evidence photograph shows a receipt and notebook on a newsroom desk, without illegible walls of text. Beside it a slim paper clipping reads "GHI CHÚ" and "Mỗi chi tiết cần một nguồn đáng tin." Right fifth of screen: an expressive medium cropped portrait of Vân seamlessly layered into the teal background, warm smile, a small collaborator label "LỤC THANH VÂN" and "Biên tập". Lower-right a single clear sunlight-yellow primary action reading "Giao hồ sơ", with a small secondary action "Quay lại". Give the screen distinctive coastal editorial identity, elegant paper layering, confident scale and subtle sense of motion in sweeping margins, not generic rounded dashboard cards or a crime evidence wall. Keep all body text readable and accurately accented. Avoid copying layouts, font treatments or icon silhouettes from Persona or Danganronpa.
